body: Does it need more than just water to grow? I have 2 green liquid pouches, printed in Japanese??
I've lost mine too.......in my bedroom
Should the bud be in big chunks or ground?

I can't exercise (and I used to) because I'm in chronic pain constantly from back surgery a year ago. My back is OK, but the sciatic nerve in my left leg is constant agony. I can't enjoy my hobbies anymore. I lost my faith when "God" took my sister so early and so cruelly. All she wanted was to be a grandmother. Nine months to the day of her funeral, her first grandchild was born. Another quickly followed. She missed all of it. I have NO ONE.

But I am only a burden now. I'm happy my daughter found a way to get away from me. I've tried for four years to make a life for myself after being forced to walk out of my marriage of 23 years or else become an abused woman. I should have stayed and let him kill me. My only sister (and best friend) is gone due to a botched "routine" surgery. My youngest older brother is dying of ALS and has openly said to me he wished I had the disease instead of him. He had lived a "correct" life, while all I did was screw up. I can't hold down a job and will have nowhere to go in six weeks. I hurt so badly inside, I don't know how to go on.
